# QCustomPlot

`qcustomplot.cpp` and `qcustomplot.h` form a separate OBJECT target. Project
integration adjusts include paths while preserving original third-party source
and embedded license notices. This directory maintenance does not upgrade the
component. Both file headers identify version 2.1.1 (6 November 2022), copyright
2011-2022 Emanuel Eichhammer, under GPL-3.0-or-later. QualPF uses the GPLv3 option;
the original notices remain intact. See the root third-party notices and
`deploy/distribution.json` for provenance and distribution obligations.

Official releases: <https://www.qcustomplot.com/index.php/download>.
